comment: cmd.c rhack():3659-3671 witness for the 0377 command byte. parse() returns (char) 0377, which rhack() treats as no command: nhbell() writes only BEL and reset_cmd_vars(TRUE) clears the count and both command queues. Covers 0377 as the first key, twice in a row, after a count that get_count() echoed, after the F prefix (the got_prefix_input re-test), and before ^A, which then finds CQ_REPEAT empty.
